questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Migrating Between MySQL Versions”?

questions.prompt: Which practice best applies “Migrating Between MySQL Versions” safely?

questions.answer_key: Build a version compatibility checklist using release notes, test fixtures, backup, rollback and application smoke tests.
questions.explanation: Build a version compatibility checklist using release notes, test fixtures, backup, rollback and application smoke tests. This makes the result reviewable and aligns with a controlled learning workflow.

questions.prompt: Before relying on an example for “Migrating Between MySQL Versions”, what should be verified?
